pages.title: Before Generating
pages.text: Use a test copy when designing a pack. Keep a copy of the world and $(thing)config/ftbquests/quests$() before replacing generated content.$(br2)All $(thing)/auram$() commands require permission level 2. The chaos command takes an explicit integer difficulty from 0 to 100; there is no bare-command default.

pages.title: A First Run
pages.text: $(thing)/auram chaos gen 50$()$(br2)Auram loads the current supported recipes, applies random modifiers, exports a datapack, then requests $(thing)/reload$(). Wait for the completion message before checking JEI.$(br2)Generation uses a time-based seed. Repeating the command creates a fresh random result.

pages.title: Starting Fresh
pages.text: To generate from the original loaded recipe set, first run:$(br2)$(thing)/auram chaos clear$()$(br2)Wait for the reload, then generate again. Otherwise the previous chaos pack is part of the currently loaded recipes.$(br2)Test important progression routes in JEI before sharing a generated pack.
